sents.zh: 商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。
sents.en: After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou.

sents.zh: 西周的王想让大家都听他的话。
sents.en: The Western Zhou king wanted everyone to listen to him.

sents.zh: 所以他说了一句很有名的话。
sents.en: So he said something that became very famous.
He said: "It is Heaven that made me king."

sents.zh: 他还说，天一直在看着每一个王。
sents.en: He also said that Heaven is always watching every king.

sents.zh: 如果王做得好，天就让他一直做下去。
sents.en: If a king does well, Heaven lets him go on.

sents.zh: 如果王做得不好，天就会把这个位子给别人。
sents.en: If a king does badly, Heaven gives the place to someone else.

sents.zh: 所以做王的人不能只想自己。
sents.en: So a king cannot think only of himself.

sents.zh: 他必须关心种田的人，也关心当兵的人。
sents.en: He must care about the farmers, and about the soldiers.

sents.zh: 那时候，很多人在田里工作。
sents.en: In those days many people worked in the fields.

sents.zh: 因为天气好，所以东西种得很多。
sents.en: Because the weather was good, a great deal was grown.

sents.zh: 家里有米，也有肉，日子过得不错。
sents.en: There was rice and meat at home, and life was not bad.

sents.zh: 王定了很多新的办法，大家都要照着做。
sents.en: The king made many new rules, and everyone had to follow them.

sents.zh: 虽然后来西周没有了，但是这个想法留了下来。
sents.en: Although the Western Zhou later ended, this idea remained.

sents.zh: 一直到今天，中国人还在说“天命”这两个字。
sents.en: To this day Chinese people still speak of the "Mandate of Heaven".
